text:
maria.devex: Heads-up: we're drafting console UX for v1 deprecation. Need to align on routing/quota signals and telemetry before we show banners.

sam.platform: TL;DR: want soft-banner + opt-in flag + per-tenant grace quotas. Start with canary.

kevin-pm: Qs: how will fallback routing interact with Dedicated? If v1 -> v2 fallback happens, we need quota mapping so tenants on Dedicated aren't unexpectedly charged or throttled.

oliver-runtime: Runtime perspective: fallback can be done at edge by mapping header `X-Client-Version` -> route. Problem: KV cache invalidations across model variants will increase latency for initial requests.

maria.devex: Proposed console flow: Banner with counts (requests last 7d), opt-in toggle labeled 'Allow v1 traffic fallback to v2', and button 'Request extension' to submit a short form to PMs.

sam.platform: telemetry we need: per-tenant rate of fallback events, latency delta pre/post, error spike after switch, and quota burn delta (tokens/day). Also tag events with `fallback_reason` (compat/capacity/other).

kevin-pm: Add guardrail: if fallback rate > 1% -> auto-revert and notify customer + SRE. Otherwise we risk silent correctness issues.

oliver-runtime: Implementation note: Gate fallback on tenancy flag + a circuit breaker in proxy. Pseudocode:
```
if tenant.allows_fallback and fallback_rate < 0.01:
  route = choose_compatible_variant(req)
else:
  return 412  # client migration required
```

maria.devex: UX copy draft pinned: 'We're sunsetting API v1 on 2025-08-01. For a temporary period, we will attempt compatible routing to v2 when possible. Enable fallback to reduce errors during migration.'

sam.platform: Also surface estimated token cost delta for tenant when routed to v2 (from telemetry batch analysis). That helps product teams decide.

kevin-pm: Action items: sam to add telemetry spec, oliver to prototype circuit-breaker, maria to design banner + extension request flow. I'll own acceptance criteria.

maria.devex: +1 I'll add mock and put on next design sync. @sam.platform can you drop a SIEM-friendly event id for the fallback metric?

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: feature/compat-fallback-probe -> staging at 2024-11-12T22:00Z :rocket:

oliver-runtime: FYI: measuring KV cache churn will need a new metric `kv_cache_miss_ratio_by_variant`. That will show whether fallback is killing cache locality.

sam.platform: noted. drafting spec now — expect PR by EOD US pacific.

kevin-pm: Thanks all. Let's keep console language conservative and avoid promising indefinite fallbacks; set clear sunset date and extension review process.

maria.devex: Agreed. I'll include the extension SLA and review checklist in the mock. End thread.
